name: codebridge
description: Lets the Claude app (voice mode included) talk to your Claude Code chat: send requests, wait for replies, answer its questions.

relayUrl.title: Relay URL
relayUrl.description: Where your Claude Bridge relay runs; the connector URL the Claude app uses is built from it

chatUrl.title: Chat connection URL
chatUrl.description: Where this computer's chats connect (a WebSocket URL); empty uses the relay URL
